  Scenario: AC9 The scanner reads through the frontend API only and every threshold is configuration (BR6, BR10)
    Given the StuckWorkflowScanner code and its deployment configuration are under review
    When the scanner reads visibility and history for a run
    Then it reads through the Temporal frontend API over mTLS and never connects to the Temporal databases
    Then the scanner identity holds no grant on the Temporal databases
    Then the stuck window, the repeat interval, the panel list and the routing rota are read from configuration and none is hard-coded

  Scenario: AC10 A status change the model does not allow is refused
    Given workflow "case-RW-2026-000123" of type CaseHoldWorkflow on task queue `rwb-platform` has closed with status COMPLETED
    When a status change from COMPLETED to RUNNING is applied to it
    Then the change is refused
    Then the workflow status remains COMPLETED and no alert is raised for the refused change
